# Apocalypse of Peter — Chapter 17
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Source:** Akhmim Fragment / Ethiopic MS, Apocalypse of Peter 17

---

*[The Ascension. The cloud of light. The final commission.]*

1. While he was still speaking, he was taken up into the heavens, and a great cloud of light received him. And we saw written upon that cloud: "This is my beloved Son in whom I am well pleased; he has kept my commandments."

2. We remained there weeping and sorrowful, because we could no longer see him.

3. Moses and Elijah, who had also gone up with him into the heavens, heard the voice of God saying to them: "Go to my holy mountain and remain there until the day of my coming, which will be fulfilled in the generation that is yet to come."

4. We fell upon our faces and praised God and the Lord. We saw the cloud draw away from us and ascend into heaven.

5. Moses and Elijah came down again from the holy mountain, weeping and lamenting, and said to us: "He has gone up. He has left us."

6. We fell upon our faces again and wept, because our Lord had departed from us.

7. But the Lord Jesus Christ was taken from our midst and went up to heaven. And a voice from heaven said: "This is my beloved Son in whom I am well pleased."

8. Many were gathered in his name, proclaimed righteous in his name, sanctified, and their sins were forgiven them.

9. Our Lord Jesus Christ said to us before his departure: "I give you authority over serpents and scorpions and over the power of the enemy, and over all manner of disease — that whatever you bind on earth shall be bound in heaven."

10. He also said to us: "Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit."

11. "And know this — as I have said to you before — the prophets have spoken concerning the things that I have shown you."

12. We praised and glorified God, and went on our way, proclaiming the kingdom of heaven everywhere in his name, and preaching repentance and forgiveness of sins throughout all the world.

---
*LOGOS note: The closing commission weaves together Matt 28:18–20 (baptismal commission), Luke 10:19 (power over serpents), and Matt 16:19 (binding and loosing). The APE closes by inscribing itself within canonical apostolic authority.*
